bugCoverageMatrix.legend: Each historical automatable failure (failure-genome F01..F20) must have >=1 direct regression, >=1 mutation/fault proof, and (where a runtime path exists) >=1 real-path/deployed replay.
bugCoverageMatrix.hollowTestNote: Every critical invariant has a mutant that fails for the intended reason (mutationCertification). Green-without-mutant is not counted as protection.

verdict: Meta-QA PARTIAL: registers + mutation certification + coverage matrix complete for shipped gates.
